As reported in a Current Report on Form 8-K filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (the “SEC”) on May 15, 2026, as amended by a Current Report on Form 8-K/A filed with the SEC on June 12, 2026, MasterCraft Boat Holdings, Inc., a Delaware corporation (the “Company”), completed the transactions (the “Transactions”) contemplated by that certain Agreement and Plan of Merger, dated as of February 5, 2026, by and among the Company, Titan Merger Sub 1, Inc., a Delaware corporation and a direct wholly owned subsidiary of the Company (“Merger Sub 1”), Titan Merger Sub 2, LLC, a Delaware limited liability company and a direct wholly owned subsidiary of the Company (“Merger Sub 2”), and Marine Products Corporation, a Delaware corporation (“Marine Products”), whereby (i) Merger Sub 1 merged with and into Marine Products (the “First Merger”), with Marine Products surviving the First Merger as a direct wholly owned subsidiary of the Company, and (ii) immediately following the First Merger, Marine Products merged with and into Merger Sub 2 (the “Second Merger”), with Merger Sub 2 surviving the Second Merger as a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company. This Current Report on Form 8-K is being filed to provide certain unaudited pro forma combined financial statements of the Company for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2026 so that such financial statements are available to be incorporated into any future registration statements (or amendments thereto). A pro forma balance sheet is not presented as of the fiscal year ended June 30, 2026, as the Company’s most recent balance sheet already reflects the Transactions. This Current Report on Form 8-K should be read in connection with the Company’s May 15, 2026 and June 12, 2026 filings referenced above, which together provide a more complete description of the Transactions.
